thread:
Carla: Tidewell reported a regression after last runtime deploy — p95 up ~45ms and tokens/sec down ~25% during burst tests. They hit it on the 'short' model family. Anyone picking this up?
Mike: Can you paste a trace id and the deploy sha?
Carla: trace=ab12f3d4, deploy=sha:9f8a7b6. Logs show many 'kernel_selector fallback' warnings. Snippet:

`````
2026-03-12T10:12:03Z WARN kernel_selector: fallback to generic kernel for attention (seq=1024) customer=tidewell
2026-03-12T10:12:04Z INFO kvcache: hit_rate=0.02 requests=1200
`````

Raj: KV cache hit rate looks low. Are these warm requests? Did they change prompt prefixes?
Carla: Customer says typical workload; spike happens when they ramp from 100->1000 concurrent calls. They use no prefix caching.
Sofia: Assigning myself to collect pprof CPU+heap during a controlled run. Can someone kick a bench run with the same concurrency curve?
Mike: I'll check kernel selector logs and kernel metadata. If fallback happening, maybe sequence length misclassification.
Raj: bench-bot can run the workload — bench command:

`````
bench-run --concurrency 1000 --ramp 60 --model short-1 --requests 50000 --trace-root ab12f3d4
`````

bench-bot: Scheduled run 1745601200, results will post here.
bench-bot: Run complete — summary: tokens/s dropped 28% vs baseline, p95 +45ms. Full result: https://bench.local/runs/1745601200
Sofia: Started pprof capture on node runtime-12, collecting 60s CPU.
Mike: I see kernel_selector logs pointing to sequence bins misaligned — bin thresholds were updated in the deploy. Rolling back that change to test.
Carla: Customer wants ETA and if we need a rollback.
Sofia: If rollback proves necessary I'll coordinate canary. For now we need to confirm perf delta is kernel-selector related — Mike will push a quick config rollback to staging.
Mike: Pushed config rollback to staging (cfg v2026-03-12-rc). Re-running bench now.
bench-bot: Staging run 1745602400 complete: tokens/s back to baseline, p95 within 5% of baseline.
Carla: :thumbsup: Customer informed. We'll schedule a minimal rollback to prod during low traffic window unless you want a more surgical fix.
Raj: Also would like to add a quick metric alert for KV cache hit rate <10% during ramps.
Sofia: Added an alert: runtime.kvcache.hit_rate < 0.10 for 5m.
Mike: I'll open a follow-up PR to make bin thresholds robust to sequence skew and add unit coverage.
Carla: Thanks team — I'll keep Tidewell updated. Next check-in after prod rollback decision. :checkered_flag:
